# CANDIDATE: VWAP_OVERNIGHT_GRINDER_KEEPER_ANALYSIS

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The VWAP anchored entry strategy (reclaim/rejection combos) can capture edge on J's winner days while avoiding losses on loser days by entering on the first VWAP reclaim or rejection bar after the first 3 RTH closes are on one side of the VWAP.

## Mechanism

Enter on the first VWAP reclaim or rejection bar (≤10:30 ET) when the first 3 RTH closes are all above or all below the VWAP. Parameters: vol_mult=1.5, proximity_dollars=0.15, lookback_bars=2, body_min_cents=0.05, premium_stop_pct=-0.14 (14% stop loss), tp1_premium_pct=0.5 (50% TP1), runner_target_pct=2.0 (200% runner target), strike_offset=2 (ITM-2 for puts), qty=3, tp1_qty_fraction=0.667, profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.1, profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.05, require_ribbon_agreement=true, ribbon_min_spread_cents=30.0. Exit: chart-stop primary, TP1 at +50% premium (sell 2/3), runner to breakeven after TP1, final exit at ribbon re-entry or 15:50 ET.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=3 corresponds to $1K-$2K account (per playbook risk-rules.md). Headline wide_pnl of $587.72 is for this account size; $1K paper account realizes ~82% of headline ($482) due to scaling.
2. **Sample bias:** Grinder ran over ~16 months (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) but keeper by_day only shows 7 days (2026-04-29 to 2026-05-07). Selection method: parameter sweep over VWAP reclaim/rejection combos. High overfit risk due to low edge_capture (40.01) and concentration on few days.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward test performed)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no real-fills check on top 3 J days)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: unknown without full backtest (shown period all non-negative).
   - Max drawdown: unknown without full backtest.
   - Blow-up scenario: strategy may suffer losses on strong trend days with no VWAP mean reversion or repeated premium stop hits. Reliance on VWAP continuity fails in low-volume/chop regimes.
6. **Concentration:** Top-2 days (5/01: 40.01, 5/05: 40.54) account for 80.55 of 587.72 wide_pnl (13.7%). Full concentration requires complete backtest; top-5 days likely >50% given low trade count (wide_n_trades=12).

## Pre-merge gate

The candidate must pass: Stage-1 backtest (to quantify baseline and J-day impact), walk-forward OOS test (edge_capture ≥ 771), real-fills validation on top 3 J days (fill slippage <±20% vs BS-sim), and concentration check (top5_pct ≤ 2.0).

## Confidence

2 / 10 -- Edge_capture of 40.01 is far below OP-16 floor of 771 (50% of 1542), indicating no viable edge. Sample is small and likely overfit to 5/01 and 5/05. Mechanism lacks robustness across regimes.
